name: week
title: Knowledge review week
subtitle: Fictional demo until you import your own records

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select title,owner,reason,priority from attention order by priority,title,reason

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select title,owner,review_due,status from review_queue order by review_due nulls first

sections.title: Article performance
sections.sql: select * from content_performance order by views desc

sections.title: Unanswered searches
sections.sql: select phrase,count(*) as searches from searches where hits=0 group by phrase order by searches desc

sections.title: Owner workload
sections.sql: select * from owner_workload order by reviews_due desc

sections.title: Evidence checks
sections.sql: select title,rule,finding,source from compliance_findings order by rule,title
